canonical.title: Weekend around L'Air du Temps — Liernu, Belgium, 2026

sources.title: L'Air du Temps — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: 2 MICHELIN Stars + Green Star (2026 Belgium guide), Liernu/Éghezée.

sources.title: L'Air du Temps — official
sources.claim: Restaurant and 11-room B&B at Rue de la Croix Monet 2, Liernu; chef Sang Hoon Degeimbre.

sources.title: L'Air du Temps — Les Chambres
sources.claim: Séjour Signature €640pp (excl. Fri/Sat eve); Séjour Suprématie €730pp; room upgrades +€20–€90.

sources.title: Resto.be — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: Closed Mon/Tue; phone +32 81 81 30 48.

sources.title: Belvicci — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: Average tasting-menu price ~€270–300; nearest non-on-site hotels: Manoir de Thorembais (5.78 km), Koru (9.86 km).

sources.title: Belvicci — L'Air du Temps SETTING
sources.claim: Double room with breakfast ~€210 avg; ranked #2 of 13 best hotels in Namur district.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — L'Air du Temps B&B
sources.claim: 4.6/5, 54 reviews; sleep quality 5.0; no A/C in rooftop rooms; no 24h reception.

sources.title: Wikipedia — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: Relocated to Liernu farmstead in 2013; team of ~20; 5-hectare vegetable garden.

sources.title: Les Ruines du Château
sources.claim: Two suites built into the ruins of Château d'Aische-en-Refail, 500 m from L'Air du Temps.

sources.title: Les Ruines — Our Rooms
sources.claim: La Charmante (jacuzzi) and L'Envoûtante (sauna under the castle tower); bookable together via underground corridor.

sources.title: RTBF — Les Ruines du Château
sources.claim: €200 all-incl. jacuzzi room, €170 sauna room; Horecatel Awards 2025 public's favourite.

sources.title: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté
sources.claim: Place d'Aische 10/12, Aische-en-Refail; 2–3 room types; free bike rentals; 9.5/10 (65 reviews).

sources.title: Château Bayard
sources.claim: 17th-century family castle in Éghezée; five bedrooms with period fireplaces, stuccoes, Louis XVI alcoves.

sources.title: Let's Go My Love — Château Bayard
sources.claim: ~€190/room/night; breakfast €15pp; email-only reservation at chambre-chateau-bayard@gmail.com.

sources.title: The Royal Snail (Namur)
sources.claim: Namur's first boutique design hotel; rates €135–€239; spa, pool, jacuzzi.

sources.title: Les Tanneurs de Namur
sources.claim: 15 restored 17th-century houses, former tanneries; 37 rooms; old-town Namur.

sources.title: Château de Namur
sources.claim: 4-star hotel atop the Citadel; 29 rooms incl. 5 suites; cable car ~7 min to old town.

sources.title: Citadelle — Underground Tour
sources.claim: 90-min guided tour, 495 m of restored galleries; advance online booking by the day before, latest.

sources.title: Citadelle — Tarifs & Horaires
sources.claim: Open daily 10–18, 1 Apr–27 Sep 2026; 4-activity Citadelle Pass €36/€32.

sources.title: Citadelle — Cable Car
sources.claim: Téléphérique €5.50 one-way / €8 return; closes 27 September.

sources.title: Téléphérique de Namur
sources.claim: 4-min ride from Place Maurice Servais, 103 m above ground at the citadel esplanade.

sources.title: Abbaye de Floreffe
sources.claim: Hour-long abbey-church tours Apr 1–Sep 30 (closed Mon except holidays) at 13:30/14:30/16:00/17:00; €8 adult.

sources.title: Visit Wallonia — Floreffe Abbey
sources.claim: Premonstratensian abbey founded 1121; mill-brewery offers tastings of abbey beers, bread and cheese.

sources.title: Les Jardins d'Annevoie
sources.claim: Main season 28 March to 11 November 2026; pre-season window 14 Feb–1 Mar.

sources.title: Annevoie — Tarifs
sources.claim: €12 adult / €9 student / €8 child (6–17) / free under 6; €35 annual pass.

sources.title: Annevoie — Practical
sources.claim: Open 09:30–17:30 (Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov), 09:30–18:30 (Jul–Aug); parking €3 for 4 h.

sources.title: Domaine du Chenoy
sources.claim: Saturday-only organic-vineyard visits & tastings, April–October.

sources.title: Visit Gembloux — Abbaye
sources.claim: Abbaye de Gembloux opens for ticketed 90-min tours on 4 summer dates only: Sat 11 Jul, Sun 26 Jul, Sat 8 Aug, Sun 23 Aug; €5 adult.

sources.title: RAVeL — Dinant–Namur
sources.claim: 28 km flat family-friendly cycle, mostly asphalt; passes Wépion and Annevoie.

sources.title: Visit Wallonia — La Meuse à vélo
sources.claim: Wallonia's first fully signposted long-distance cycle route, 147 km, overlaps EuroVelo 19.

sources.title: Musée de la Fraise (Wépion)
sources.claim: Open Tue–Sun 11:00–18:00 April to September; Fraise'tival on 2 August 2026.

sources.title: Walibi Belgium
sources.claim: ~22 km north of Liernu; reopens 4 April 2026; tickets from €48 advance.

sources.title: Walibi — Mecalodon
sources.claim: 2026 headline ride: family Gerstlauer launched coaster with three top-hat hills, in new Dock World zone.

sources.title: Maredsous — Guided Tours
sources.claim: Tours every Sat/Sun/holiday at 14:00 and 16:00 (15:30 in winter); €9 adult / free under 12.

sources.title: Visit Wallonia — Maredsous
sources.claim: Molignée valley near Denée, ~30–33 km south of Liernu; founded 1872.

sources.title: Château de Spontin
sources.claim: Working drawbridge; Jul–Aug Tue–Sun 10–17; Sep–Oct Wed/Sat/Sun 14–17; €8 adult; call ahead +32 451 03 25 20.

sources.title: Grotte Saint-Antoine — Crupet
sources.claim: Free always-open 1900–1903 plaster grotto with famous devil scene; 10,000 visitors/yr.

sources.title: Wikiloc — Gros Chêne loop
sources.claim: Liernu signed 7 km / ~2-hour loop walk starting at the millennial oak.

sources.title: L'Avenir — Gros Chêne
sources.claim: Liernu's oak is dated as millennial; 30 May 2026 Brotherhood Chapter at the tree.

sources.title: Musée Félicien Rops
sources.claim: Rue Fumal 12, Namur; 10–18 (last entry 17), closed Mon and 3rd weekend Sept; €5/€8.

sources.title: Visit Wallonia — KIKK Festival
sources.claim: KIKK Festival 2026 runs 21–25 October in central Namur.

sources.title: KIKK Festival — official
sources.claim: Digital & Creative Cultures festival, Namur.

sources.title: Hack the Narrative — CSLabs
sources.claim: Free 27–29 Mar 2026 hackathon at Faculté d'informatique UNamur.

sources.title: UNamur — CSLabs Hackathon
sources.claim: Fri 27 Mar 17:30 → Sun 29 Mar 18:00 at Faculté d'informatique, Rue Grandgagnage.

sources.title: FOSDEM 2026
sources.claim: 31 Jan & 1 Feb 2026, Brussels (ULB Solbosch); ~45 km from Liernu.

sources.title: Éghezée — TEC Flexitec
sources.claim: Liernu has no scheduled bus, only an on-demand TEC Flexitec stop.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Liernu→Namur
sources.claim: 13-min drive Liernu to Namur.

sources.title: Taxi Proxi — Namur tariffs
sources.claim: Approx €11 (5 km), €20 (10 km), €38 (20 km) standard class.

sources.title: Quality Lodgings — L'Air du Temps
sources.claim: 11 on-site bedrooms in a restored white farmstead; 5-hectare vegetable garden.
